ideas.title: The scope of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: Investigate the extent of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota, including the number of cases and the amount of money involved.
questions: How many cases of Medicaid fraud have been reported in Minnesota?
What is the total amount of money involved in these schemes?
ideas.insight: This story would investigate the scope of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota, including the number of cases and the amount of money involved. It would follow the money to uncover the entities and individuals involved in these schemes.

ideas.title: The impact of Medicaid provider removal
ideas.description: Investigate the impact of Minnesota DHS removing 3,400+ Medicaid providers on the state's healthcare system.
questions: What is the impact of removing 3,400+ Medicaid providers on the state's healthcare system?
How many patients will be affected by this removal?
ideas.insight: This story would investigate the impact of Minnesota DHS removing 3,400+ Medicaid providers on the state's healthcare system. It would analyze data on the number of patients affected and the potential consequences for the state's healthcare system.
